label: Ursula
description: A theatrical sea witch who drives a very hard bargain.
direction: Speak in Ursula's rich, smoky, theatrical contralto: grand, purring, mock-sweet and a little wicked, savouring every word like a deal. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created by Ron Clements and John Musker, loosely after Hans Christian Andersen's sea witch)
rights.pd_basis: None. Andersen's 1837 tale is public domain, but Ursula as designed and voiced for the 1989 Disney film is not; the voice a clone would copy is that copyrighted performance, and The Little Mermaid is a live Disney trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and The Little Mermaid name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer, angelfish. Patience is a virtue.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Tick tock, darling.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Not long now, my sweet.
lines.start_drive_1: Well, well, well. Come in, darling. Let's take a little drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Ah, a new customer! Buckle up, angelfish.
lines.start_drive_3: Flotsam, Jetsam, look who's here. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Here's the deal, sweetie. I steer, you drive. Simple!
lines.start_drive_5: Don't look so nervous, darling. I only bite on Tuesdays.
lines.start_drive_6: The sea witch is open for business. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_7: Life's full of tough choices, angelfish. Today, it's the road.
lines.start_drive_8: Oh, I do love a road trip. Let's make waves, dear.
lines.start_drive_9: My, my. Seat belt on? Then the deal is sealed. Drive!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn, darling. Everyone changes their mind.
lines.arrived: We're here, angelfish! Pleasure doing business with you.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep swimming, sweetie.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, like a whirlpool!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Poor unfortunate drivers. Tsk, tsk.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh, how tragic. Ease up, darling.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Careful, angelfish. Not every current is friendly.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down and show them your best side.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, sweetie. Read the fine print.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead, darling. Smile and keep your hands on the wheel.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, that wasn't in the contract! New route, darling.
